thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: High 5xx rate detected for tenant 'Artemis Corp' in eu-west-1 on dedicated pool artemis-dedicated-eu1. Trigger: 5xx spike >50% over 2m. Pager: Alicia (on-call). Severity: P1. Links: https://mon.redwood/influx/alerts/1767543210 :alarm_clock:
Alicia (on-call): I'm up — seeing ~60% 5xx from the tenant's ingress. Confirmed from NLB and envoy metrics.
Ravi (SRE): grabbing logs. Are we sure it's pool-level and not model backend?
Jules (SE): Artemis support pinged — they report latency and failed responses for some internal workflows. No config changes on their side.
Katarina (Support): Artemis (customer) reports errors since ~08:02 UTC. They're on a dedicated VPC + Dedicated pool. Escalating to account exec (Anya).
Anya (Account Exec): I'm on the line with customer. They need an ETA and mitigation plan.
Ravi (SRE): quick triage: envoy 502/504s, model hosts showing OOM kill patterns and sudden queue length growth. Candidate root cause: warm capacity exhaustion on artemis-dedicated-eu1 after a traffic spike.
Alicia (on-call): Can we shift traffic to warm standby in eu-west-2? We have artemis-warm-eu2 warmed last night (2x capacity).
Jules (SE): Yes. Plan: 1) Enable pool-level drain for artemis-dedicated-eu1 2) Patch routing policy to route new requests to artemis-warm-eu2 3) Update DNS CNAME for tenant-specific hostname with low TTL 30s for cutover 4) Monitor.
Ravi (SRE): I'll start the LB route update. Running internal command: 
```
# route change (internal)
redwoodctl route update --tenant artemis --from artimis-dedicated-eu1 --to artimis-warm-eu2 --weight 0.0
```
Alicia (on-call): Hold — do not set to 0 immediately. We should canary 10% for 2 minutes then ramp if healthy.
Ravi (SRE): ack. Starting 10% shift. Executed: `redwoodctl route update --tenant artemis --weight 0.1`
DeployBot: Deploy event: routing-policy patch for tenant artemis applied by ravisingh@infra (rev c7d4). CI verifications passed.
Katarina (Support): Notifying Artemis support contact: "We're shifting 10% of traffic to warm standby while we validate responses. We'll keep you updated."
Anya (Account Exec): Customer asked if DNS will change — they use custom CNAME. They prefer we avoid full DNS swap if possible. Can we keep their hostname and do LB routing only?
Jules (SE): Yes, for now LB routing suffices. DNS cutover only if LB route can't handle load. We'll keep DNS change as a fallback with TTL 30s.
Ravi (SRE): Metrics: 10% canary OK after 90s — error rate on canary hosts ~2% (baseline 1.5%). No OOM on warm hosts.
Alicia (on-call): Continue ramp: 25% for 2m, 50% for 2m, then 100%. Ravi, coordinate with infra for cache warm-up (KV prefix cache) — cold cache could cause backend spikes.
Ravi (SRE): Running cache warm-up: `redis-cli -h kv-cache.euw2.cluster --rpush warm-queue "{tenant:artemis}"` — starting background priming job.
Katarina (Support): Customer reports intermittent timeouts on older sessions. Could be sticky session IP affinity into overloaded hosts. Are we draining sessions?
Jules (SE): We'll enable session affinity eviction: `redwoodctl session evict --tenant artemis --drain-time 60s` — that'll gracefully force new sessions to go to warm hosts.
Ravi (SRE): Ramp to 25% -> executed. Monitoring logs.
oncall-bot: ALERT: Model host host-112 in artemis-dedicated-eu1 reported OOM at 08:12:10 UTC.
Alicia (on-call): Pulling host list. If we continue to see host-level OOMs, we'll isolate hosts and shift traffic away.
Ravi (SRE): 50% ramp at 08:15 executed. Error rate trending down cluster-wide from 60% -> 8% over 6 mins. Warm hosts stable.
Anya (Account Exec): Artemis is asking for a short post-mortem and timeline for root-cause. Tell them we prevented extended outage and are stabilizing.
Katarina (Support): on it. Sending interim update: "We've routed traffic to warm standby in eu-west-2 and are monitoring. No data loss, a small portion of requests experienced errors earlier; retries succeeded. Will follow up with RCA."
Jules (SE): Prepare fallback DNS cutover in case warm pool becomes insufficient: steps: set tenant CNAME to artemis-fallback.redwood-eu2.internal with TTL 30, announce maintenance window, coordinate with infra to pre-provision TLS certs.
Ravi (SRE): Further checks: model queue depth normalized after draining overloaded hosts. No new OOMs in last 4m.
Alicia (on-call): Keep 50% for 2 more minutes then evaluate for full 100%. Also check billing/usage flags so customer isn't surprised by surge to warm.
Ravi (SRE): 100% shift executed at 08:20. `redwoodctl route update --tenant artemis --weight 1.0` — all traffic now to artemis-warm-eu2.
DeployBot: Routing policy update completed (rev c7d5).
Katarina (Support): Customer confirmed end-user flows working now. They've started smoke tests and see success.
Anya (Account Exec): I'll schedule a customer call 09:00 UTC for a full rundown and next steps.
Alicia (on-call): Post-cutover actions: 1) mark artimis-dedicated-eu1 for capacity health check 2) run heap/core analysis for OOMs 3) patch runtime memory limits if needed 4) produce incident summary.
Ravi (SRE): Capturing logs: `kubectl logs -n artimis artimis-host-112 --since=10m > /tmp/artemis-host-oom.log` and uploading to /sre/incidents/1767543210/artemis-host-oom.log
Jules (SE): Noting a config drift: model-serving config had concurrency bump that wasn't deployed to warm pool — investigating whether that contributed to overload.
Katarina (Support): Closing line to customer: "We're keeping traffic on your warm standby while we complete a health pass and root cause analysis. We'll not cut any billing surprises; account team will follow up." :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: Severity downgraded to P2 at 08:27 UTC after full traffic shift and stabilization.
Alicia (on-call): We'll keep this channel open for the postmortem. If anything regresses, page SRE immediately.
Anya (Account Exec): Thanks team. I'll join the postmortem and share notes with Artemis.
Ravi (SRE): Leaving actions: follow-up tasks assigned in tracker: ISSUE-ARTEMIS-1123 (heap analysis), ISSUE-ARTEMIS-1124 (routing review), ISSUE-ARTEMIS-1125 (runbook update).
Jules (SE): Also add an automated warm-up job to run after capacity scale events for dedicated pools.
Katarina (Support): Final customer update sent at 08:30 UTC.
Alicia (on-call): Closing incident channel after handoff to SRE for RCA. Good job all. :thumbsup:
